verses.text: The LORD’s word came to Micah of Moresheth during the reigns of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah. Micah saw this message about Samaria and Jerusalem.
Listen, all you peoples! Pay attention, earth and everyone in it! The Lord GOD will testify against you from his holy temple.
Look, the LORD is coming from his place. He will come down and walk across the earth’s heights.
The mountains will melt beneath him and the valleys split open, like wax before a fire, like water pouring down a steep slope.
“All this is because Jacob rebelled and Israel sinned. What is Jacob’s rebellion? Isn’t it Samaria? What are Judah’s high places? Isn’t it Jerusalem?
“So I will turn Samaria into rubble in an open field, a place for planting vineyards. I will pour her stones down into the valley and expose her foundations.

“All her carved idols will be smashed. All the gifts to her temple will be burned, and I will destroy every image. She collected these things through a prostitute’s earnings, and they will return to a prostitute’s pay.”
Because of this, I will mourn and wail. I will walk stripped and naked. I will howl like jackals and cry like ostriches.
Her wound can’t be healed; it has reached Judah. It has come right to the gate of my people, all the way to Jerusalem.
Don’t announce it in Gath. Don’t cry there. In Beth Ophrah, roll in the dust.
Move on, you who live in Shaphir, stripped and ashamed. Those in Zaanan won’t come out. The wailing in Beth Ezel takes away its shelter from you.
Those living in Maroth wait anxiously for good news, but disaster has come down from the LORD to Jerusalem’s gate.
Harness your chariot to a swift horse, you people of Lachish. You were the beginning of sin for daughter Zion, because Israel’s rebellion was found in you.
So you will give a farewell gift to Moresheth Gath. The houses of Achzib will fail the kings of Israel.
I will bring a conqueror against you, people of Mareshah. Israel’s glory will come to Adullam.
Shave your heads and cut your hair for the children you love. Make your baldness as wide as a vulture’s, because your children are going into exile.”
